title: The pushforward of a sheaf of sets under a continuous map is a sheaf

difficulty_reason: 5 行、推前层是层：Y 上开覆盖取原像得 X 上开覆盖 f^{-1}(V)=∪f^{-1}(V_j)；f_*F 的层条件逐字就是 F 在该覆盖上的层条件，故成立。承重（原像覆盖、层条件转移）都在 span 内；无外部引用。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-pushforward-sheaf (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 2233-2238

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: for an open covering V = union V_j in Y the preimages f^{-1}(V_j) form an open covering of f^{-1}(V) in X, so the sheaf condition of F on X translates directly into the sheaf condition of f_*F on Y (source lines 2240-2244)
